matchPoints.title: Match Length
matchPoints.help: The first player to win this many points wins the match. A win is worth one point, a gammon two and a backgammon three.

help.enabled: **Enabled**: Winning before your opponent has borne off a single checker is a gammon and scores two points. If they still have a checker on the bar or in your home board, it is a backgammon and scores three.

default.title: Single Game
default.description: One game: the first to bear off every checker wins

match.title: Match to 5
match.description: First to five points, gammons count double

error.illegalMove: That move is not allowed with these dice.

goal.title: Winning the Game
description: Move all fifteen of your checkers into your home board, the six points in front of you on the right, and then bear them off the board.
The first player to bear off every checker wins the game.

movement.title: Moving Checkers
description: Roll two dice and move a checker for each one. Click a highlighted checker to see every point it can reach, then click the point.
A double is played four times. If you can use both dice you must, and if only one can be played it has to be the higher one.

hitting.title: Hitting
description: Land on a point with a single opposing checker to hit it: it goes to the bar and has to come back in from the start.
You cannot land on a point your opponent holds with two or more checkers. A checker on the bar must come in before anything else can move.

bearingOff.title: Bearing Off
description: Once all your checkers are in your home board, a die can take a checker off the point that matches it.
Win before your opponent bears off any checker for a gammon, worth two points in a match.
